title: 1 person dead, 1 missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Bella Coola, B.C.
summary: One person is dead and another is missing after a suspected grizzly bear attack in Bella Coola, B.C.

blocks.text: One person is dead and another is missing after a suspected grizzly bear attack in Bella Coola, B.C.
Pair was reported missing on Sunday
A team of conservation officers is in Bella Coola, B.C., investigating a suspected fatal grizzly bear attack.
One person was found dead in the Snooka West Trail area Monday afternoon, following search efforts by RCMP and search and rescue crews.
The pair was reported missing on Sunday.
